AppearanceConfig.description: The `launcher.appearance` section: colour mode and row presentation, not behavior.

color_scheme.description: Light or dark: `system` follows the desktop, `light` and `dark` force one.

icons.description: Whether result rows show the application's icon. The preset supplies the default.

preset.description: The named layout preset supplying the defaults for this section.

theme.description: The palette: `system` follows the desktop, anything else names a curated theme.

tint.description: Whether the launcher background is translucent. Translucency, not blur.

installed.description: The ids of the installed extensions.

close_on_focus_loss.description: Whether the launcher hides when it loses keyboard focus.

hotkey.description: The global chord that toggles the launcher, as `modifier+key`.

keybinding.description: The navigation chord scheme: `default` (the platform's, vim on Linux), `vim` or `emacs`.

max_results.description: How many results the launcher shows. `0` shows none.

quick_launch.description: Whether Ctrl+1..9 launches the first through ninth result.

wrap_navigation.description: Whether moving past the last result selects the first, and the reverse.

RootEntrypointSettings.description: Per-entrypoint root search settings, keyed by entrypoint id under its provider.

alias.description: An extra search term the entrypoint answers to.

enabled.description: Whether the entrypoint appears in root search.

shortcut.description: A hotkey that runs the entrypoint directly, e.g. `ctrl+shift+c`.

RootProviderSettings.description: Per-provider root search settings, keyed by provider id (e.g. `applications`).

enabled.description: Whether the provider contributes to root search at all.

entrypoints.description: Settings for individual entrypoints of this provider.

description:
A parsed `vicinae.json`.

[`Config::default`] is the fully-defaulted configuration and is what an empty file produces.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema this file follows, for editors. Ignored by the launcher.

fallbacks.description: Root items offered when a search has no match, as `provider:entrypoint` ids.

favorites.description: Root items pinned to the top of the empty search, as `provider:entrypoint` ids.

providers.description: Root search settings per provider, keyed by provider id.

title: vicinae.json
